name: Doory-Art
description: Open-source design editor in your browser. A self-hosted Canva alternative.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, uploaded images and videos, fonts, elements, exports, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Doory editor, API, live editing and admin, published on host as 6143

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address people use to open Doory, with no slash at the end. Change localhost to your server IP, for example http://192.168.1.10:6143, or use your own https:// domain. Share links and emails use it.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email for the first admin account. Put your own email here. Left blank, it is admin@example.com. Only used while there is no admin yet.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first admin account. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. It is shown in the app log and saved in the data folder. Or type your own. Only used while there is no admin yet; change it later in Doory.
